info.name: Community Maintenance API
info.description:
Walks the maintenance workflow: reporting, own-only visibility, the technician directory, assignment, the status flow (ASSIGNED comes only from assigning, closed is final), mandatory resolution notes, aging, filters, the dashboard and security.
Start the backend first (http://localhost:8110). Repeatable: it registers a fresh resident and uses a uniquely named location and technician each run.

item.name: Register a fresh resident for this run

exec: pm.test("Eight categories, four priorities", () => { const m = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(m.categories.length).to.eql(8); pm.expect(m.priorities).to.eql(["LOW", "MEDIUM", "HIGH", "EMERGENCY"]); });

pm.test("Open and fresh, with a reference and no technician", () => { pm.expect(r.status).to.eql("OPEN"); pm.expect(r.number).to.match(/^MR-\d+$/); pm.expect(r.aging).to.eql("FRESH"); pm.expect(r.technicianName).to.eql(null); pm.expect(r.allowedNext).to.eql(["ASSIGNED"]); });

item.name: Report a low priority garden problem
Another resident sees none of them
A bad phone number is rejected

exec: pm.test("Plumber, active, no jobs", () => { pm.expect(t.trade).to.eql("PLUMBING"); pm.expect(t.active).to.be.true; pm.expect(t.activeJobs).to.eql(0); });

item.name: The same name is rejected (case ignored)
The queue shows the leak, emergencies and old ones first

exec: pm.test("High before low", () => { const l = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(l.length).to.eql(2); pm.expect(l[0].priority).to.eql("HIGH"); });

item.name: Assign without a technician is rejected
Moving to assigned needs a technician
An open request cannot be started
The resident sees who is coming
The technician now has a job
A busy technician cannot be made unavailable
Resolving before starting is a conflict

exec: pm.test("Resolved, no aging", () => { const r = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(r.status).to.eql("RESOLVED"); pm.expect(r.resolutionNotes).to.eql("Replaced the corroded joint"); pm.expect(r.aging).to.eql(null); });

item.name: The resident reads what was done

exec: pm.test("Closed, nothing further", () => { const r = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(r.status).to.eql("CLOSED"); pm.expect(r.allowedNext).to.eql([]); });

item.name: A closed request cannot be changed
A closed request cannot be assigned

exec: pm.test("Only the closed leak", () => { const l = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(l.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(l[0].status).to.eql("CLOSED"); });
pm.test("The open garden one is fresh", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().length).to.eql(1));
